Name: qise
One-line description: AI-first runtime security framework for AI agents, centered on multi-layer guards, SLM/LLM/rule checks, and fail-closed execution protection.
One-line description zh: 面向智能体的运行时安全框架，集成规则、小模型与大模型检测。

Name: WhitzardAgent homepage
One-line description: Public homepage for WhitzardAgent, used to present the organization, projects, and research assets.

Name: snowl
One-line description: A safety evaluation framework for AI agents, designed to support agent safety benchmarks and risk evaluation workflows.
One-line description zh: 智能体安全评测框架，用于组织基准、风险测试与评测流程。

Name: AgentGuard
One-line description: Attribute-based access control framework for tool-use LLM agents, with policy specification, runtime inspection, and auditing support.
One-line description zh: 智能体运行时访问控制框架，支持策略配置、执行检查与审计。

Name: LLMPentest
One-line description: Measurement and evaluation codebase for LLM-based penetration testing capability and behavior.
One-line description zh: 测量大模型渗透测试能力与行为。

Name: Thought-Aligner
One-line description: Plug-and-play thought-level correction module for improving behavioral safety of tool-use agents before risky actions are executed.
One-line description zh: 在风险行动前校准工具型智能体推理。

Name: qitos
One-line description: Torch-like, agent-native framework for researchers building reproducible LLM agents, harnesses, trajectories, and evaluation workflows.
One-line description zh: 面向研究者的智能体框架，用于复现实验、轨迹与评测。

Name: cyberhunter
One-line description: Cybersecurity corpus mining and filtering pipeline for extracting high-quality cyber training data from large web corpora.
One-line description zh: 从大规模网络语料中筛选高质量安全训练数据。

Name: snowl-evals
One-line description: Benchmark integration layer for snowl, connecting third-party agent safety and frontier-risk evaluations into a common workflow.
One-line description zh: 统一接入第三方智能体安全与前沿风险评测。

Name: qitos-zoo
One-line description: Collection of high-quality agent examples and reproductions built on top of qitos.

Name: agentir
One-line description: Compiler infrastructure for agentic trajectories, designed as an LLVM-style intermediate representation and conversion toolkit for agent traces.
One-line description zh: 智能体轨迹的中间表示与转换工具。

Name: MirrorGuard
One-line description: Simulation-to-real reasoning-correction framework and VLM for safer computer-use agents operating over GUI environments.
One-line description zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的仿真到真实推理校准框架。

Name: WhitzardGen
One-line description: AIGC generation engine for content safety and AIGC detection workflows.

Name: YOGA
One-line description: Yet Another General-purpose Agent: an extensible and modular generalist agent framework.
One-line description zh: 模块化、可扩展的通用智能体框架。

Name: NVWA Project
One-line description: Frontier AI safety research project focused on autonomy risk, silicon-based life emergence, proliferation, and control technologies.
One-line description zh: 研究自主性、扩散、失控与控制技术等前沿风险。

Name: Mirror-GUI
One-line description: LLM-based GUI simulator for synthesizing and evaluating agentic desktop interaction trajectories.
One-line description zh: 用于合成和评测桌面智能体轨迹的 GUI 模拟器。

Name: XuanwuBox
One-line description: Secure execution layer for agentic runtime environments, positioned as an AI security advisor inside Docker-style agent sandboxes.
One-line description zh: 面向智能体运行环境的安全执行层，控制容器化沙箱风险。

Name: IntentionSpawn
One-line description: Early-stage project around intention generation or intention-oriented agent behavior research.

Name: ReasoningShield
One-line description: Content-safety detection system for monitoring reasoning traces of large reasoning models.
One-line description zh: 检测大型推理模型思维轨迹中的内容风险。

Name: IntentNet
One-line description: Fine-tuned model for evaluating whether an AI agent's reasoning contains deceptive, manipulative, or malicious intent in multi-turn interactions.
One-line description zh: 识别多轮交互中的欺骗、操纵与恶意意图。

Name: TrustNet
One-line description: Fine-tuned model for scoring a user's degree of trust in AI responses during multi-turn human-AI interactions.
One-line description zh: 评估多轮人机交互中的用户信任程度。

Name: CyberSecurity-100B
One-line description: Large quality-filtered bilingual cybersecurity corpus for continual pre-training, with cyber relevance scoring, topic labels, code-aware splits, and structured metadata.
One-line description zh: 面向持续预训练的大规模双语网络安全语料。

Name: CyberSecurity-1M
One-line description: Curated 1.19M-record cybersecurity knowledge dataset covering vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, incident response, security tools, CTF, frameworks, and Chinese security content.
One-line description zh: 覆盖漏洞、威胁情报、响应、工具与 CTF 的精选数据。

Name: CyberRepo-10K
One-line description: Dataset of 7,670 real-world vulnerability audit tasks with verified GitHub repositories, fix commits, patch diffs, and vulnerable code checkouts.
One-line description zh: 包含仓库、修复提交、补丁与漏洞版本的审计任务集。

Name: CyberTrainer collection
One-line description: Hugging Face collection grouping CyberSecurity-1M, CyberSecurity-100B, and CyberRepo-10K as the data foundation for cyber model training.
One-line description zh: 汇集网络安全语料与漏洞审计任务的训练数据集合。

Name: AgentIR Collection
One-line description: Hugging Face collection of agent trajectory datasets auto-converted by AgentIR into multiple target formats.

Name: AgentTrove-OpenAI
One-line description: AgentTrove trajectory subset converted into OpenAI chat messages format with native tool calls and tool-role messages.

Name: AgentTrove-Anthropic
One-line description: AgentTrove trajectory subset converted into Anthropic-compatible chat/tool-use format via AgentIR.

Name: AgentTrove-OpenHands
One-line description: AgentTrove trajectory subset converted into OpenHands-style agent trajectory format via AgentIR.

Name: AgentTrove-Hermes
One-line description: AgentTrove trajectory subset converted into Hermes-style training format via AgentIR.

Name: AgentTrove-AgentIR
One-line description: Canonical AgentIR representation of AgentTrove trajectories for further conversion into model- or framework-specific training formats.

Name: ClaudeCode-OpenAI
One-line description: Claude Code trajectory subset converted into OpenAI chat messages format with tool-use structure for agent training.

Name: ClaudeCode-Anthropic
One-line description: Claude Code trajectory subset converted into Anthropic-compatible agent/tool-use format via AgentIR.

Name: ClaudeCode-OpenHands
One-line description: Claude Code trajectory subset converted into OpenHands-style interaction format via AgentIR.

Name: ClaudeCode-Hermes
One-line description: Claude Code trajectory subset converted into Hermes-style model training format via AgentIR.

Name: ClaudeCode-AgentIR
One-line description: Canonical AgentIR representation of Claude Code trajectories for reproducible conversion into multiple agent training formats.
